refName.localBranchAlreadyExistsChooseAn.en: Local branch {{name}} already exists. Choose another branch name.
refName.localBranchAlreadyExistsChooseAn.zh-CN: 本地分支 {{name}} 已存在，请选择其他分支名称。

refName.localBranchNamesConflictAndChoos.en: Local branch names conflict: {{name}} and {{name2}}. Choose another branch name.
refName.localBranchNamesConflictAndChoos.zh-CN: 本地分支名称 {{name}} 与 {{name2}} 冲突，请选择其他分支名称。

refName.branchNamesCannotStartWithAHyphe.en: Branch names cannot start with a hyphen.
refName.branchNamesCannotStartWithAHyphe.zh-CN: 分支名称不能以连字符开头。

refName.branchNamesCannotContainSpacesTr.en: Branch names cannot contain spaces. Try feature/ux-flow.
refName.branchNamesCannotContainSpacesTr.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含空格，可尝试 feature/ux-flow。

refName.branchNamesCannotContainControlC.en: Branch names cannot contain control characters.
refName.branchNamesCannotContainControlC.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含控制字符。

refName.branchNamesCannotContainOrBacksl.en: Branch names cannot contain ~, ^, :, ?, *, [, or backslash.
refName.branchNamesCannotContainOrBacksl.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含 ~、^、:、?、*、[ 或反斜杠。

refName.branchNamesCannotContainTwoConse.en: Branch names cannot contain two consecutive dots.
refName.branchNamesCannotContainTwoConse.zh-CN: 分支名称不能包含两个连续的点。

refName.branchNamesCannotStartOrEndWithA.en: Branch names cannot start or end with a slash, or contain consecutive slashes.
refName.branchNamesCannotStartOrEndWithA.zh-CN: 分支名称不能以斜杠开头或结尾，也不能包含连续斜杠。

refName.branchNameSegmentsCannotStartWit.en: Branch name segments cannot start with a dot.
refName.branchNameSegmentsCannotStartWit.zh-CN: 分支名称的路径段不能以点开头。

refName.branchNameSegmentsCannotEndWithL.en: Branch name segments cannot end with .lock.
refName.branchNameSegmentsCannotEndWithL.zh-CN: 分支名称的路径段不能以 .lock 结尾。

refName.branchNamesCannotEndWithADot.en: Branch names cannot end with a dot.
refName.branchNamesCannotEndWithADot.zh-CN: 分支名称不能以点结尾。

refName.aBranchNameCannotBeOnly.en: A branch name cannot be only @.
